extracted.name: Homemade Buttermilk Ranch Dressing
extracted.description: This creamy homemade buttermilk ranch dressing is not only perfect for salads but also serves as a delicious dip for veggies, chips, or chicken wings.
ingredient_lines: freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk mayonnaise and buttermilk in a medium bowl until smooth. Add parsley, garlic powder, salt, onion powder, dill, and pepper. Whisk until blended together. Place in the refrigerator until flavors have melded, about 20 minutes.
